analysis.visual_description: On the tables. The pocket tables open on the bed. Yesterday's writing is rubbed to a faint smear. The stylus is in his hand and has not yet touched. The grey cloak is on the peg.
On the tables. He holds the stylus over the smear and does not write a sum, a title, or the name of a play.
On the tables. The same leaf. The smear is no darker. Downstairs, a cup is set on a board, out of sight.
